source.title: Primer Reporte de Zonas críticas por peligros geológicos en la cuenca de la quebrada Canto Grande

bounded_identity_evidence.reported_position: right bank of the Rímac, N-NE of Lima
bounded_identity_evidence.reason_geometry_blocked: The public report provides map figures and descriptive cartography but no machine-readable vector geometry or frozen coordinate sequence suitable for direct publication.

bounded_event_evidence.supported_claim: INGEMMET states that exceptional rainfall affected the upper Canto Grande subbasin at Jicamarca Anexo 22 / Quebrada Media Luna in 2002 and documents debris-flow material and destruction of precarious and masonry housing in Media Luna.

next_gate: Obtain official vector hydrography or independently reproducible DEM/channel geometry for Canto Grande and Media Luna, then freeze each child and outlet separately before map publication or collector coupling.
